---
title: "Viewer 3D – Modèle photogrammétrique (textures originales)"
format: html
---

<div id="three-canvas" style="width: 100%; height: 600px; margin-top: 20px;"></div>

<script type="importmap">
  {
    "imports": {
      "three": "https://unpkg.com/three@0.128.0/build/three.module.js",
      "three/addons/": "https://unpkg.com/three@0.128.0/examples/jsm/"
    }
  }
</script>

<script type="module">
  import * as THREE from 'three';
  import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';
  import { OBJLoader } from 'three/addons/loaders/OBJLoader.js';
  import { MTLLoader } from 'three/addons/loaders/MTLLoader.js';

  // --- Initialisation ---
  const scene = new THREE.Scene();
  scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x111122);

  const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45, 1, 0.1, 1000);
  camera.position.set(4, 3, 5);

  const container = document.getElementById('three-canvas');
  const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
  renderer.setSize(container.clientWidth, container.clientHeight);
  renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;  // les ombres améliorent le réalisme
  container.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

  // --- Repères (optionnels – vous pouvez les désactiver si ça gêne) ---
  const gridHelper = new THREE.GridHelper(10, 20, 0x888888, 0x444444);
  scene.add(gridHelper);
  const axesHelper = new THREE.AxesHelper(3);
  scene.add(axesHelper);

  // --- Lumières : nécessaires pour voir les textures correctement ---
  const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.7);
  scene.add(ambientLight);
  const dirLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1);
  dirLight.position.set(2, 5, 3);
  dirLight.castShadow = true;
  scene.add(dirLight);
  const fillLight = new THREE.PointLight(0x88aaff, 0.5);
  fillLight.position.set(-2, 1, 3);
  scene.add(fillLight);
  const backLight = new THREE.PointLight(0xffaa66, 0.4);
  backLight.position.set(0, 1, -3);
  scene.add(backLight);

  // --- Chargement du MTL + OBJ (textures conservées) ---
  const mtlLoader = new MTLLoader();
  // Important : le chemin doit pointer vers le dossier contenant le .mtl (et les textures relatives)
  mtlLoader.load('assets/3DModel.mtl', (materials) => {
    materials.preload();
    const objLoader = new OBJLoader();
    objLoader.setMaterials(materials);
    objLoader.load('assets/3DModel.obj', (object) => {
      console.log('✅ Modèle chargé avec textures');

      // Ajuster l'échelle et centrer automatiquement (sans toucher aux matériaux)
      const box = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(object);
      const center = box.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3());
      const size = box.getSize(new THREE.Vector3());
      const maxDim = Math.max(size.x, size.y, size.z);
      const scale = 2.5 / maxDim;   // Taille finale de l'objet dans la scène
      object.scale.set(scale, scale, scale);
      object.position.set(-center.x * scale, -center.y * scale, -center.z * scale);
      
      scene.add(object);
      console.log(`Dimensions : ${size.x.toFixed(2)} x ${size.y.toFixed(2)} x ${size.z.toFixed(2)} → échelle ${scale.toFixed(4)}`);

      // Recentrer la caméra sur l'objet
      controls.target.set(0, 0, 0);
      controls.update();
    }, undefined, (error) => {
      console.error('❌ Erreur chargement OBJ :', error);
    });
  }, undefined, (error) => {
    console.error('❌ Erreur chargement MTL :', error);
    console.warn('Vérifiez que le fichier 3DModel.mtl existe et que les textures sont accessibles.');
  });

  // --- Contrôles orbitaux ---
  const controls = new OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
  controls.enableDamping = true;
  controls.autoRotate = false;
  controls.screenSpacePanning = true;

  // --- Animation ---
  function animate() {
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    controls.update();
    renderer.render(scene, camera);
  }
  animate();

  // --- Redimensionnement ---
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    const width = container.clientWidth;
    const height = container.clientHeight;
    camera.aspect = width / height;
    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    renderer.setSize(width, height);
  });
  window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize'));
</script>
